fields.Name: T159 - Issues App Open Issue
fields.Description: In the Issues app, find issue MC-0031: search or filter the issue list for 'MC-0031' (or 'Gorsemere'), then open the issue. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away.
fields.ExpectedOutcomes:
{
  "goalCompleted": true,
  "finalUrlPattern": "^http://localhost:4200/app/issues",
  "minConfidence": 0.7,
  "maxSteps": 30,
  "judgeValidationCriteria": [
    "The Issues app shows a list of issues",
    "Issue MC-0031 'Please update my employer — Gorsemere Cheesemaking Supply no longer current' is open and shows Status Closed and type Data Correction",
    "No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages"
  ]
}
